item_name: Rothco Vietnam Veteran Supreme Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Wear your service with Rothco’s Vietnam Veteran Supreme Low Profile Insignia Cap.
description: Wear your service with Rothco’s Vietnam Veteran Supreme Low Profile Insignia Cap. The front panel of this low-profile cap displays the Vietnam Veteran insignia and text “Vietnam Veteran” embroidered in stark gold lettering. This Vietnam Veteran hat is constructed with a brushed cotton twill material for a comfortably soft feel, with a tough, rugged durability. This Veteran cap includes a padded sweatband for enhanced comfort and all-day wear. The Hook & loop closure on the back of this Vietnam Vet hat lets you adjust the cap to your perfect fit.
